review_notes: The Planner-public set is derived from all expanded Family catalogs and contains 23 Function capabilities plus 6 Macro capabilities.
Five recorded cases cover 26 capabilities; distance_between_points, equal_length_ray_point and line_intersection_point are covered by normal typed synthetic executions.
Every public Function has exactly one teaching disposition and one visual disposition; all public Macros have RecipeSpec, MacroTeachingSpec and unit-aligned VisualSpec coverage.
The two previously misclassified public Macros now remain one atomic FunctionalPlan Step and project two ordered teaching and visual units each.
All reviewed teaching and visual bindings are driven by generic specs, typed public runtime values and exact semantic references rather than problem IDs, fixed point names or answer values.
Generated HTML remains rebuildable output and is intentionally not stored as a fixture.
